english.meaning: after a verb: not have enough time to do it, cannot manage it in time
english.note: Used after a verb, as in 做唔切 (can't finish in time).

exampleSentences.english: Because there wasn’t time to finish the payroll stuff.
exampleSentences.traditional: 因為做唔切嗰啲出糧嗰啲嘢囖。
